text:
sam.b: FYI — AcmeCorp ticket #12345 asking for an adhoc header-based routing escape: they want `x-acme-mode: legacy` to pin traffic to their legacy model for 24h to debug output drift. They asked to bypass canary/sticky routing. attaching ticket link.
nora: We should not approve without an audit trail + explicit TTL and approver. Also need to show impact in console (cost/latency).
aj: From infra: header-match rule is straightforward but beware of header spoofing. If we allow this, require a signed override or strong auth header (HMAC) and make rule evaluation strict.
liam.s: sec note — no bypass without a signed token. Require `X-Override-Signature` tied to org admin keys or support app. Also enforce per-org rate limits and an automatic kill switch after TTL. No permanent exemptions.
cassie.product: Product suggestion: add an "Ad-hoc override" modal in the Console that captures: owner (approver), justification, ticket id, TTL (default 12h, max 72h), and audit export. Show estimated token cost delta and latency delta before confirm.
deploy-bot: created tentative rule id `route-adhoc-2468901234` in staging (awaiting approvals). CI checks queued.
sam.b: quick config sketch for the gateway rule:
```
match:
  headers:
    x-acme-mode: "legacy"
conditions:
  signed_override: true
action:
  route: acme-legacy-model-v1
  override: true
  ttl_seconds: 86400
  audit: true
```
nora: Telemetry: tag every request with `routing.override=true`, `override_variant=legacy`, `override_actor=acme-admin`. Emit a counter `overrides.invocations` with org label and `overrides.active` gauge. Also track fallback events.
aj: Quotas/billing: ensure this doesn't bypass quota checks or per-org RPS limits. We should instrument so charges and quota consumption are attributed to the org as usual.
liam.s: Add healthcheck fallback: if legacy model returns 5xx or P95 latency > 2s for 1m, automatically fail over to stable route and fire alert to oncall + owner. Record rollback in audit.
cassie.product: Ownership: @sam.b to collect security signoff and update support ticket. I'll draft the Console mock for the modal (will include approver dropdown and TTL slider).
nora: Next steps: sam open PR with rule + gating + telemetry; aj will add HMAC verification; liam will review health/fallback hooks. Targeting landing in ~4 working hours if approvals come back quick.
sec-bot: Audit entry created: action=create_override user=sam.b org=acmecorp id=route-adhoc-2468901234 ttl=86400
sam.b: thanks — will post updates in the ticket and ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
